name: Shiritsu Onsen Gakuen ~Sukumizu de Ofuro ni Haiccha Dame Desu ka?~
original_name: 私立温泉学園～スク水でお風呂に入っちゃダメですか？～
source:
There is a prestige girls' school. Granting a founder's intention, there are baths on the school premises and students enjoy having a bath. However, the number of students who wear swinsuit when having a bath increases. The ringleader is Karen. She tries to change the school rules and allow students to wear a swimsuit when having a bath. Yukako, a teacher, objects to it and she orders the main character, a rookie teacher, to stop it. If he fails, he will be fired...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081201133544/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010566]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
有一所名门女子学校。遵循创校人的理念，校园内设有浴池，学生们平日也会入浴。然而，穿泳衣洗澡的学生越来越多，始作俑者是桐原可怜。她想修改校规，允许学生穿泳衣入浴。教师西王寺由华子对此反对，命令刚入职的主角阻止她。若失败，他就会被解雇……

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081201133544/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010566]Eroge Shop[/url]]
